With SR cadence (60f charge + release latency per shot) uptime is near-continuous while firing but LAPSES around reload: last hit + 3s expires before reload(159f≈2.65s) + recharge(1s) + latency completes, so a ~1s dead window per magazine exists.

loadBearingSet: skill2:Max Ammunition Capacity ▲ 2 round(s) for 10 sec
notes: Three reconciliation points. (1) SHARED-PRIOR MISREAD RISK, skill1: the schema's defPct comment ('inert in v1') is about SELF DEF and is the trap most likely to make a driver silently drop the enemy DEF ▼ — an enemy-side DEF reduction is damage-live for the WHOLE team via the ATK−DEF term. I marked it GAP because the visible StatKey list exposes no explicitly enemy-DEF-labeled channel; if the engine consumes enemy-targeted defPct (or an equivalent boss-DEF channel), the disposition upgrades to FAITHFUL — but the A/B assertion (zero the block, whole-team totals must move) is the test either way, and if the engine truly has no consumer the line belongs in unmodeled with the gap surfaced, not silently dropped. (2) FIXTURE HAZARD, burst: himeno is Burst II and controlComp pins crown in the B2 slot — the driver must construct the comp so himeno's burstCast actually fires for the positive assertions (and, adversarially, a comp where crown bursts instead is exactly the fixture that separates burstCast from a fullBurstEnter misread; helm as the fixed B3 keeps FBs chaining either way and conveniently doubles as the second SR for the skill2 target-set assertion). (3) skill2's interval seconds are OUTSIDE this prose (datamined skillCooldownsSec) — the test must pin the CD it assumes and assert the apply-spacing against it; if CD ≤ 10s the duration-vs-passive distinction collapses observationally and the assertion should then lean on expiresFrame stamps rather than coverage gaps. Also note the deliberate near-collision in skill2's wording: '▲ 2 round(s)' (magnitude) vs the taxonomy's 'for N round(s)' (duration) — the durationShots misread is the single most damaging plausible error on this kit.
